uq_market_entitlements_active_item.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_market_entitlements_active_item ON public.market_entitlements USING btree (user_id, item_id, scope) WHERE ((scope = 'item'::text) AND (status = 'active'::text))

uq_market_entitlements_active_subproduct.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_market_entitlements_active_subproduct ON public.market_entitlements USING btree (user_id, subproduct_id, scope) WHERE ((scope = 'subproduct'::text) AND (status = 'active'::text))

uq_market_entitlements_active_file.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_market_entitlements_active_file ON public.market_entitlements USING btree (user_id, file_id, scope) WHERE ((scope = 'file'::text) AND (status = 'active'::text))

uq_market_entitlements_legacy_source.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_market_entitlements_legacy_source ON public.market_entitlements USING btree (source_purchase_id, legacy_asset_kind, scope) WHERE ((scope = 'legacy_asset'::text) AND (source_purchase_id IS NOT NULL))

uq_market_purchase_orders_user_idempoten.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_market_purchase_orders_user_idempotency ON public.market_purchase_orders USING btree (user_id, idempotency_key) WHERE (idempotency_key IS NOT NULL)
